desc:
⚔️ Merge To Fight

🗡️ Swing your sword at training dummies to gain Power!
👹 Fight goblins and monsters across 35 dungeon areas and win their swords!
🔀 Merge two matching swords into one that's twice as strong!
💰 Your swords earn Cash every second, so upgrade your drops, luck and training!
👑 Rebirth for permanent boosts, beat every boss and become the strongest fighter!

👍 Like, favourite, and follow if you enjoyed the game!
